note: Desktop builds are unsigned preview packages today. v0.7.1 fixes renderer RPC reconnects across reload and live-update handoffs while retaining the v0.7.0 Content Shield and Pear Plugins features. Signed/notarized installers land as signing credentials are wired in; this file is regenerated from verified release assets.

platforms.label: macOS
platforms.openNote: Not yet notarized. After downloading: right-click the app -> Open -> Open to get past Gatekeeper the first time (or run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine on the .app).

platforms.label: Windows
platforms.openNote: The MSIX is currently unsigned, so Windows rejects a normal double-click install. Download it only if you understand sideloading (Developer Mode + Add-AppxPackage). The former Pear link is not an alternative launch path.

platforms.label: Linux
platforms.openNote: After downloading: chmod +x the file and run it. The AppImage bundles the GTK4/libadwaita runtime pieces needed by the native shell on standard desktop distributions.

p2p.note: Legacy migration record only. It is not a Pear v3 launch or install path; use the native package for this device.

android.note: A signed .apk for direct download (and a Google Play listing) are in progress.

ios.note: iOS cannot be installed from a download; it will ship via the App Store and TestFlight once review is complete.
